opiniones.author: Rex W.
opiniones.title: Personalised travel
opiniones.content:
We flew into Malaga and Java at Marabella-in-style picked us up in a beautifully polished and clean vehicle. On to the Picasso museum in Malaga, then Granada, where we stayed two nights at the Parador.

This was so good as didn’t have the hassle of driving or taxis and we had help with our luggage. Also visiting Malaga which we probably wouldn’t have done was a bonus.

Marabella-in -style then picked us up at Granada and we drove to a Cordoba and met with Elena who gave us three hours of insightful explanation of the mosque and its integration into the catholic community. Lunch was fabulous with wonderful tapas, and then onto Seville to our hotel there with our driver Java. This was an exercise in which we certainly had to pay a little extra, but for peace of mind, feeling secure and all stress taken out of the travel, it was so worth it. I would definitely use this company again, their staff are fabulous. Well done to all involved.

opiniones.author: Vrisayda P.
opiniones.title: A wonderful experience of Spain
opiniones.content: You MUST ‚ ABSOLUTELY MUST contact Julio at Marbella in-Style. I just recently made a trip to Marbella, Spain. My friend and I decided that we would make our own reservations instead of going through a travel agency. Boy are we glad we did. We contacted Julio at Marbella in-Style to schedule our own personal tours (not the ones on a bus with 20 other people). Our tours went from Marbella to Granada, Ronda, Cordoba, and Tangiers. It was so easy and very convenient. Julio and his driver picked us up in a private car at the time we wanted, took us where we wanted to go, and ate when and where we wanted. Julios motto is Anything is possible. It was awesome. Julio is very well versed in English and other languages and very knowledgeable in the history of Spain and the places he took us. Julio has a great personality and above all we felt safe and well taken care of by him. I highly recommend Marbella in-Style as a top of the line service and money well spent. I only wish there was a Julio and Marbella in-Style everywhere I travel. I definitely will contact Julio and Marbella in-Style next time I visit Costa del Sol. All I can say is, Thank you Julio from the bottom of my heart for a wonderful experience of Spain. I will be sure to refer all of my friends and family to Marbella in-Style.

opiniones.author: Marianne D.
opiniones.title: No Disappointments with Marbella In Style Tours
opiniones.content:
My group of 6 people took four private tours with Marbella in Style: Granada, Seville, Ronda and Gibraltar. Lana was our guide for Granada, Seville, and Ronda. She did an excellent job. Very informative and fun too. Carl was our guide for Gibraltar and he knew everything about the place. Our driver was wonderful too.

If you are looking for a comfortable, reliable, tour paced to your liking go with Marbella in Style.

No complaints whatsoever.

opiniones.content: I visited this office with questions about a private tour to Granada. When it turned out that our schedules would not mesh, Lana went out of her way to help me arrange a tour I could do n my own.

opiniones.author: kenrose77777
opiniones.title: Thanks Marbella in Style.
opiniones.content:
Six of us visited Marbella from 7 to11 May and engaged Marbella-in-Style for our private guided tours to Granada (Alhambra), Ronda and Cordoba. We enjoyed our tour to Alhambra especially the Garden which was very beautiful. We stopped at Ruta de Veleto restaurant for lunch, recommended by Julio. It was a great choice as the food and service were excellent.

Of all the private tours, Ronda was the most memorable. It is a small town but the architecture and scenery were captivating. Our visit to the 2 wineries in Ronda were beyond our expectation. In fact, we spent too much time at the second winery hosted by Miguel and Isabel. The home cooked food served by Isabel paired with their wines were amazing. Leo, our driver knowing that we love Gambas (prawns), on his own initiative, requested Isabel to cooked garlic Gambas for us. We have so much fun that we went a bit overboard and bought 20 cases of wines from them.

What impressed us most about Marbella in Style was our driver Leo. Though his spoken English was not great, he made every effort to communicate and recommend us places to visit and restaurants to go for our meals. He was punctual, hardworking and helpful.

Thanks Marbella in Style.

opiniones.author: Nancy O.
opiniones.title: Amazing days in Granada and Seville
opiniones.content: My husband and I and another couple spent a week in Marbella this past April. We enjoyed two all-day tours with Marbella-in-Style, one day to Granada and Alhambra, one day to Seville. Julio was an excellent guide. The two hour drive each way was very comfortable in their mini-van. The day spent in each city was well planned with an efficient use of time that allowed us to see and spend adequate time at all the main sights of each city. Julio spoke excellent English and was extremely knowledgeable and capable in sharing the history, background, culture of the cities. All the sights were amazing and we thoroughly enjoyed our days in both cities. I highly recommend Julio and Marbella-in-Style

opiniones.author: Sharon F.
opiniones.title: Visit To Granada
opiniones.content:
My husband and I had a private tour of Granada for the day. Julio, our guide was very friendly, spoke excellent English, informative and showed us all the sights we wanted to see. Our driver was very good and we had a very comfortable journey there and back. The guide at the Al-Hambra was excellent and we had a great day out. We were shown the streets of Granada and witnessed students hanging out on the streets and in the snack bars. We found the tour fascinating from start to finish and we were delighted with the whole experience.

I would definitely recommend this tour company if you fancy a private tour seeing the sights of Spain.

opiniones.author: Ellie P.
opiniones.title: Private tours to Seville, Granada and Ronda
opiniones.content: We booked three different tours with Julio from Marbella in Style. Each was unique and wonderful. Julio told us about the history of each place we visited, brought us to interesting out of the way places to eat, lunch in Granada at Ruta del Veleta. Tour to Ronda was amazing. Visited the bullfighting stadium, walked along the gorge and then headed to wine country. First we visited Juaquin Fernandez Bodega. Excellent tour of the winery, delicious wine. Next up was lunch at Bodega Garcia Hildago where we toured the vineyard, ate grapes right off the vine, and had an amazing home-cooked meal made by Isabella alongside wines made by Miguel. Top notch all the way. By the time we parted, we felt like Julio was not just our host but a good friend.

Would highly recommend. she was so much friendlier than another tour company we contacted, and was the main reason for us hiring Marbella in Style.

opiniones.author: Steven T.
opiniones.title: Seville In A Day!
opiniones.content:
I took my elderly parents and aunt to Seville on a private tour with Marbella In Style while holidaying in Marbella. I had been to Seville many years ago for a long weekend.

The Mercedes mini van turned up on bang on time outside our apartments. It was very spacious and very comfortable. Our guide Lana was with us on the journey there and back. We stopped for a comfort break halfway and arrived in Seville feeling very fresh. The day was amazing! We saw all the key sights including the Alcazar and its gardens, Cathedral and Exhibition palace with ample time to walk around all. We had a leisurely lunch in the old quarter, and a carriage ride around the town and gardens.

Seville is small – the historic sights are all close by. So we actually got to see as much as I saw on my long weekend! It was very surprising how much Lana managed to fit in and it was all done like clockwork!

Lana was wonderful – the tickets to all the sights were pre-booked by her and we didn’t queue for anything. Lana was very friendly, professional and my parents loved her! We had great fun. Lana was informative but we also laughed a great deal!

Communications with Marbella In Style were swift, courteous and very professional. I was so pleased I had booked a private tour with them rather than an ordinary mass tour. We had the mini van and Lana to ourselves and the driver was brilliant, driving us to Seville and back in comfort and style without any problems. Lana was aware of my parents’ mobility issues and took this into account and was very kind and sweet with them. I have taken several private tours in Italy and France and this was undoubtedly the best.

I cannot recommend Marbella In Style highly enough, it was worth every Euro, the highlight of my parents’ and aunt’s trip, and will use them again in the future.

opiniones.title: Fabulous Day Trip to Seville
opiniones.content: Our family of four is staying in Marbella for a few weeks. We did a private day trip to Seville with Lana. She was a great guide and was extremely knowledgable. The sites were fantastic to see, and Lana’s explanations added a lot of important context and history. Seville is a bit far from Marbella so be prepared for a lengthy drive. That said, the visit to Seville is still well worth it.

opiniones.author: Marylou T.
opiniones.title: One day Tangier tour
opiniones.content: We thoroughly enjoyed our tour of Tangier with Molad as a guide along with Oscar as our companion who spent the entire day with us, getting onto the ferry and through the immigration process. Molad was knowledgeable of every stop that we went to and explained the history of each. We saw the Kasbah, Medina, Caves of Hercules and Cape Spartel (I believe it’s called), the spot where the Mediterranean and Atlantic meet. He also explained sights that we were seeing as we were driving to each spot on the tour. He pointed out various homes of Royalty and other interesting places. He spoke English very well and was polite and receptive to our needs, as was Oscar. My husband sometimes has trouble walking and uses a walking stick. The streets were mostly cobblestone and uneven and Oscar was there and attentive to him the entire day. We would recommend this tour to anybody who wants the experience of a day in Tangier.

opiniones.author: Bradford R.
opiniones.title: Great for families
opiniones.content: Our main reason for hiring a private tour was the fact that we had a 4 month old baby. We needed a tour company that would be patient and understanding for us taking breaks to feed and change the baby, and Julio and his team were most accommodating. We took tours to Seville and Morocco. Enjoyed both trips immensely. Would highly recommend. Lana was great in helping us plan these trips…she was so much friendlier than another tour company we contacted, and was the main reason for us hiring Marbella in Style.

opiniones.author: Kirsi V.
opiniones.title: The Tangier guide was exceptional!
opiniones.content:
We did two day trips from Marbella to Tangier and Granada&Alhambra. The guide we had in Tangier was amazing. We got a great tour! And want needs to be mentioned, all the kids aging 5-17 years enjoyed the day. And everything worked, no delays, no problems. Wau!

The other trip was to Granada&Alhambra. There we had some diffidulties as the guide was not 100 % top of all things. But she did make her best effort.

The price was a bit high, but as we did two trips, we got a bit of a discount.

All in all, we recommend!

opiniones.author: Charles G.
opiniones.title: Julio is the Best
opiniones.content: We did two tours with Julio, one to Ronda and the other to Morocco. Julio was very knowledgeable and most accommodating to all out needs. When in Morocco we were met by his associate and driver. Julio was with us there also, didn’t just send us on the ferry and tell us to look for them. We felt very safe at all times. Can’t thank him enough, when we go back which we will he will definitely be our tour guide again.

opiniones.author: Linda G.
opiniones.title: Julio is Fab
opiniones.content:
Julio was the Best!

We did day trips to Ronda and Morocco.

Julio made both trips enjoyable and interesting. He is knowledgeable, shared past and present history of the areas, was efficient, personable and trustworthy!

We felt very confident and safe with him.

Both were trips of a life-time. Thanks Julio!

The Iowa group

opiniones.author: Deborah M.
opiniones.title: Tangier & Ronda
opiniones.content: We had a fabulous time with Julio during our vacation in Marbella Spain. We would never have ventured so far without his guidance, connections and knowledge of what to see and where to go. Ronda’s countryside is beautiful and the wineries were fantastic – so much hospitality! The Tangier tour is absolutely amazing. We felt we touched paradise while at Le Mirage drinking mint tea. Aziz (tour guide in Tangier) was delightful and entertaining. We highly recommend Marbella In-Style tour guide services if you are going to visit Marbella. It is an opportunity of a lifetime to experience south Spain with Julio.

opiniones.author: Torkel K.
opiniones.title: private wine tour of Ronda
opiniones.content: A marvellous day which we bought as a birthday present. Everyone was indeed very satisfied with the day. Except for the prize. We found it a bit too expensive

opiniones.author: Tracie M.
opiniones.title: Ronda wine tour
opiniones.content: Our group had an excellent experience guided by Lana through vineyards and the town of Ronda. Everyone was amazed and Lana was full of great information!

opiniones.author: Janet E.
opiniones.title: Wine Tour of Ronda and Gibraltar Tour
opiniones.content: I booked the wine tour of Rhonda and the Gibraltar tour for a group of 6. I highly recommend both tours. Our contact person in Marbella in Style was Lana. She was exceptional. She was very prompt in her communications with us and went to a great extent to accommodate our needs and schedule the tours to maximize our enjoyment of them. She was our tour guide for the Ronda tour and was professional, informative, and a lot of fun to be with. The tour began with a traditional Spanish breakfast that was delicious. The morning wine tour was very informative. The tour of Ronda was interesting and fun. The afternoon wine tour included a meal that was one of the best meals we had in Spain. The couple that ran the vineyard was charming. We bought several bottles of wine at both vineyards that we visited. Lana was not our tour guide in Gibraltar; she scheduled a tour with a local guide who was professional, experienced, and very informative. We chose the tour option with the driver and were glad that we did not have to bother with the drive from our hotel to Gibraltar and parking. The tour itself is fascinating. A first visit to Gibraltar definitely requires a guide to get the most from the visit.

opiniones.author: Christina D.
opiniones.title: Wine Tour of Ronda
opiniones.content: HIGHLY RECOMMEND Marbella in-style! We traveled to Marbella with friends and booked this tour prior to arrival. Lana was our fabulous guide & Leo was our driver in a private, comfortable bus – they were phenomenal!! Lana was very engaged with us and we became fast friends. She had much to share and was a terrific host. Lunch was amazing! So much food & the hosts where very kind. This trip was worth every penny & would use them again on future travels. If I could give more than 5 stars for this company, I would! Thank you for a lovely day.

opiniones.author: Michelle L.
opiniones.title: Wine tasting tour in Rhonda
opiniones.content: Just returned from a corporate event we hosted in Spain, and we booked a wine tasting tour in Rhonda with Julio. The tour was well organised, authentic and welcoming. We thoroughly enjoyed it and Julio’s knowledge of the wine making process was impressive. We will definitely be using the service again!

opiniones.author: Peter A.
opiniones.title: Ronda Wine Tour
opiniones.content: We had a fantastic day tasting wine in the Ronda valley. Good Food. Good Wine. Good Company. Thank you and we will see you again.

opiniones.author: Kenneth L.
opiniones.title: Amazing Tour
opiniones.content:
Six of us visited Marbella from 7 to11 May and engaged Marbella-in-Style for our private guided tours to Granada (Alhambra), Ronda and Cordoba. We enjoyed our tour to Alhambra especially the Garden which was very beautiful. We stopped at Ruta de Veleto restaurant for lunch, recommended by Julio. It was a great choice as the food and service were excellent.

Of all the private tours, Ronda was the most memorable. It is a small town but the architecture and scenery were captivating. Our visit to the 2 wineries in Ronda were beyond our expectation. In fact, we spent too much time at the second winery hosted by Miguel and Isabel. The home cooked food served by Isabel paired with their wines were amazing. Leo, our driver knowing that we love Gambas (prawns), on his own initiative, requested Isabel to cooked garlic Gambas for us. We have so much fun that we went a bit overboard and bought 20 cases of wines from them.

What impressed us most about Marbella in Style was our driver Leo. Though his spoken English was not great, he made every effort to communicate and recommend us places to visit and restaurants to go for our meals. He was punctual, hardworking and helpful.

Thanks Marbella in Style.

opiniones.author: Jamie P.
opiniones.title: Perfect wine tasting tour in Ronda , Spain
opiniones.content: This was much better than expected. Julio was a great tour guide, with extensive knowledge of the town of Ronda and wineries. The 2 wineries we visited, were very informative, and courteous, and the 1st one we visited produced my favourite wine, but the 2nd one , while the wines were not just as good, the husband & wife team who run this small boutique winery were extremely hospitipal and the lunch they made us was exemplary. I will definately be doing this tour again. Jamie Patterson.

opiniones.author: muellerjim
opiniones.title: Julio is Fab!
opiniones.content:
Julio was the Best!

We did day trips to Ronda and Morocco.

Julio made both trips enjoyable and interesting. He is knowledgeable, shared past and present history of the areas, was efficient, personable and trustworthy!

We felt very confident and safe with him.

Both were trips of a life-time. Thanks Julio!

The Iowa group

opiniones.author: Ellie P.
opiniones.title: Private tours to Seville, Granada and Ronda
opiniones.content: We booked three different tours with Julio from Marbella in Style. Each was unique and wonderful. Julio told us about the history of each place we visited, brought us to interesting out of the way places to eat, lunch in Granada at Ruta del Veleta. Tour to Ronda was amazing. Visited the bullfighting stadium, walked along the gorge and then headed to wine country. First we visited Juaquin Fernandez Bodega. Excellent tour of the winery, delicious wine. Next up was lunch at Bodega Garcia Hildago where we toured the vineyard, ate grapes right off the vine, and had an amazing home-cooked meal made by Isabella alongside wines made by Miguel. Top notch all the way. By the time we parted, we felt like Julio was not just our host but a good friend.

opiniones.author: William S.
opiniones.title: Outstanding tour
opiniones.content: Jullio was an outstanding tour guide. The vehicle he pick us up in was clean and comfortable. He arrived at our hotel at the exact time he said he would be there. On the way to Ronda Spain he pointed out many of the sites along the way. His English was easy to understand and he has a great sense of humor. Upon our arrival in Ronda he took us on an outstanding walking tour missing almost all of the crowds who were there so we we could see the great views. He explained everything we were looking at in great detail. Never did he stop at any tourist traps for shopping which was greatly appreciated. We left Ronda on our way to two wineries which were outstanding. At the first winery we tasted 6 different red wines all were great. Then on to the next winery where we tasted wine and had an outstanding lunch prepared by the owners of that winery. To say it was over the top would be a miss statement. The food was Delicious and the wine was great. If you are in the Costa Del Sol area and looking for a great day trip this one comes highly recommended.

opiniones.author: Emma S.
opiniones.title: Superb two-days wine tasting tour in Marbella and Ronda!
opiniones.content:
We had the pleasure of beeing guided by Julio for two wonderful days in Marbella and in Ronda.

The first day started with a guided walking tour in the old town Marbella with Julio. Then we ended up with wine tasting in the center of the old town. It is a culinary sanctuary for high quality olive oil and wine from the Andalusian region. David, the owner and our host, shared his knowledge enthusiastically and a chef was cooking wonderful dishes, while we tasted wines, olive oils and delicious food from the region. This place is a gem!

Next day we were also picked up at the house in the morning. On our way from Marbella to Ronda we stopped up in the mountains to have a traditionally Spanish mountain breakfast at “Venta La Parrilla” before we drove to the first vineyard: “Bodega Descalzos Viejos”.

We were met by one of the owner Flavio Salesi, that took us for a walk in the old garden surrounding the house, an old convent founded in 1505. He and his partner (both architects) bought the place in 1998 and restored it. After a walk in the beautiful garden we sat down under an old avocado tree and while Flavio told us of the wines and life in general – it was magical sitting there and we never wanted it to end!

Next stop on our route was a small ecological family driven vineyard: Bodega Garcia Hidalgo. This little vineyard was funded in 2006. We vent for a little walk among the vines and señor Garcia Hidalgo told us about the grapes and the production. Inside the winery and the cellar we tasted grape must and and young wine before the wine tasting. The Señora had cooked us a delicious meal – lots of courses and we sat outside in the shadow and tasted the wines and had a very, very nice meal.

Because of the hospitality at both of the vineyards we were a bit late according to schedule and for our guided walk in Ronda. But regardless of this, Julio took his time to show us the highlights of this beautiful, old city before we headed back to the house.

Thank you so much for memorable and eventful days Julio – we will be back and we will definitively recommend Marbella in-Style!

opiniones.author: Louis J.
opiniones.title: Very nice day
opiniones.content: A very interesting and copious day, with good wines and good food. I will definitely use Marbella in-Style again.

opiniones.author: Jennifer S.
opiniones.title: Super Day Touring Ronda
opiniones.content: Julio took our group of six on a one day tour of Ronda and the surrounding vineyards. Like many of the other reviewers, we began with a local breakfast that was a great introduction to some local foods but not for anyons who is on a diet! We then had a wonderful tour of a local vineyard, Joaquin Fernandez, and a good introduction to winemaking in the area as well as some lovely wines. Next we transitioned to a walking tour of Ronda and the finished the day with a tour and lunch provided by Isabelle at her and her husbands small vineyard. The food was obviously prepared with love by her tia (aunt). It was like having dinner at a long lost relatives house – we felt like part of the family when we left. Julio provided us with a good mix of history and current events all along the way. We highly recommend using him and his service.

opiniones.author: Isj1275
opiniones.title: Beautiful Day in Ronda
opiniones.content: We had wonderful day visiting with Ronda. Julio is an amazing tour guide. We enjoyed the entire day. Beautiful city, tour and amazing time of the year. We loved the fact that Julio gave us time to stop and shop as we walked through Ronda. Great and amazing time in Ronda. It is worth your time to visit Ronda.

opiniones.author: Hilde H.
opiniones.title: Two-days wine tour- in old Marbella, vineyards and Ronda
opiniones.content: We had the pleasure of being guided by Julio and his team for two eventful days. The first day we were guided around in old Marbella which was very charming. We enjoyed a tasting of good interesting wines and oliveoils in the shop D*Oliva, were we also had a very nice lunch. The next day we went over the mountains towards Ronda. On our way we had a stop for breakfast. It was interesting. Traditional Spanish mountain breakfast are definitely not for people dieting! We were then taken to Bodega Descalzos Viejos. An old monastery, now owned by two architects, neatly restored to a vineyard. We were welcomed by Flavio, one of the owners who showed us around and told us more of life, the beautiful place, than the wine we were tasting. Never the less we could have stayed there the rest of the day or more! It was a pure pleasure! Never the less, we did learn some more about the art of winemaking! The next vineyard we visited, Bodega Garcia Hidalgo was even smaller. We were also here met with great hospitality. Here we had a big very nice lunch in the garden made with care by the wife of the owner. We ended our tour in this area with a brief guided walk in Ronda were we saw the highlights of the city before heading back to Marbella. We will definitely recommend Julio and his company to anyone who are planning tours and events in this area.

opiniones.author: Andre B.
opiniones.title: An interesting Ronda tour with wine and food
opiniones.content: We were picked up by minibus and transported to Ronda where we had a very interesting guided tour of Ronda with lunch at a small vineyard. Exciting and interesting.

opiniones.author: Kas W.
opiniones.title: Fantastic day!!
opiniones.content: We had a brilliant day sampling wines from the area and had an amazing lunch on one of the vineyards, made from fresh local produce! Was definitely the highlight of our trip, and definitely to be repeated! Julio was a great guide and we really enjoyed his company and his knowledge of the region. Highly recommend using Marbella in-Style for any tours or concierge services!

opiniones.author: Serena M.
opiniones.title: A must day out
opiniones.content:
What a wonderful day out with Julio! Everyone enjoyed it- age range from 20 to 85. Started the day with a wonderful Spanish breakfast and the day just got better and better. Ronda is beautiful and Julio was a great guide, with a vast amount of knowledge.

The highlight of the day was meeting Miguel and Isabella at their organic vineyard.

What a surprise was in store as we not only tasted wonderful wine but also wonderful food prepared by Isabella, eaten in a wonderful courtyard overlooking beautiful vistas.What wonderful warm and generous people.

opiniones.author: Janal J.
opiniones.title: Visit to Ronda and vineyards
opiniones.content: Excellent way to spend a day. Julio was the perfect guide and Ronda was beautiful! The wine tasting trips were both excellent but the second was definitely the favourite, perfect way to end the day. A authentic home cooked meal with beautiful wine thanks to lovely Isabel and Miguel. Cant recommend enough!

opiniones.author: Lana A.
opiniones.title: Ronda and two vineyards
opiniones.content:
We had a great day which first started with a typical Spanish breakfast. Despite the fact that some of us are very picky the breakfast was very good. Furthermore, we visited an amazing organic winery where we saw how they produced their wine, and of course tasted it. Then we went to Ronda where we had a guided tour around the city. The most amazing experience of the trip was the last vineyard.This was a small winery where Miguel showed us around, while Isabell made wonderful Spanish food with amazingly good wine.

We had a fantastic day and Julio was a very clever guide. I highly recommend this trip.

opiniones.author: Sandra T.
opiniones.title: A perfect day
opiniones.content: This trip was just perfect! Excellent food and vine (and a lot of food and vine – you will not leave hungry). Very nice balance between guiding and tasting. Absolutely worth the money! Book it!

opiniones.author: Kirsti S.
opiniones.title: Superb trip to Ronda and vineyard
opiniones.content: We were seven friends that went with Julio as guide to Ronda and the vineyards. Perfect day from start to end: pick up at apartment, really nice authentic breakfast, visit at vineyard with tasting, guided tour in Ronda and finally lunch at the vineyard of Isabell and Miguel which served a really good 8 hours course authentic Spanish lunch with wines from their own yard. Absolutely recommended!

opiniones.author: Eva McG.
opiniones.title: Highly recommended! Definite must experience when in Marbs
opiniones.content: I cannot recommend this experience highly enough to tourists looking for a picturesque, educational and fun filled day out. The food, drink, scenery and tour guide are all 5* quality. We had authentic Spanish food and wine, with a personal touch from the vineyard owners. The Rhonda valley was stunning and unique, and the town was a lovely walk. BOOK IT NOW! You won’t regret it!

opiniones.author: Harry D.
opiniones.title: Wine tasting Ronda
opiniones.content: We had a great family happening. Picked up in Marbella with VP van and a full day program in Ronda where two wineries were visited and an excellent lunch was served. The support was friendly and professional. I can recommend this trip to anyone. Have fun. Harry de Wit

opiniones.author: Joseph E.
opiniones.title: Ronda Luxury Wine Tour
opiniones.content: We had a terrific time. Patricia was our guide and Joel was the driver. Both were very personable and friendly. I plan on going back to Spain in 2015 and do the tour once again. The people at Zabel Bodega, Miguel and Maribel were wonderful and made us feel like family. We enjoyed them tremendously and this tour will be at the top of our agenda. Don’t change what you are doing. The tour is private and much more enjoyable, unlike the typical tour where you show up and tour buses have filled the parking lots. The tours you provide are very intimate and 1 on 1 with the owners of the Bodegas. Muchas gracias por todo.

opiniones.author: Camille G.
opiniones.title: Charleston SC (USA) visits Marbella Spain
opiniones.content: My friends and I from South Carolina (USA) recently visited Marbella Spain and had the extreme pleasure of touring with Julio as our guide through the unbelievably gorgeous wine country of Ronda, Spain. Julio went above and beyond to make sure our experience was one that will always be remembered. The moment we met Julio it was as though we had known him forever… warm, personable, funny, bright, not to mention extremely knowledgeable on all topics. His interactions with all of us were great. Julio introduced us to a delicious Spanish breakfast, two beautiful wineries, took us on a tour of the Town of Ronda, and last but not least, the blast we had with him exploring the bull ring. Our only regret was that we didn’t get a hold of Julio at the beginning of our vacation… Before I forget – cannot leave out Leo… great driver ‚Äì he and Julio make a great team!!!!! Thanks a million!!!!!! Cannot stop telling EVERYBODY about Julio and ‚ÄúMarbella-in-Style‚Äù…

opiniones.author: Ryan S.
opiniones.title: One of the highlights of our time in Marbella
opiniones.content: The wine tour was certainly one of the highlights of our time in Marbella. Firstly, Julio was really a great tour co-originator and guide. From the first minute, he was engaging and interesting, and made even the traveling between wine farms a joy. The food that he provided during the tour was simply amazing. And I mean it was amazing 🙂 Our tour consisted out of 2 wine farm visits, as well as a tour around Ronda. Both wine farms were small and intimate. The wine makers went out of their way to provide information on their farms and their wines. Thank you

opiniones.author: Meresa M.
opiniones.title: Houston TX (USA) Marbella/Ronda Wine Tour
opiniones.content: The private wine tour and walking tour of Ronda was one of our most memorable events of our entire visit in Spain. Julio was so accommodating and informative! We had a group of 8 and Julio arranged for a mini-bus pick up at the local residence in which we were staying. He stopped to allow us a light authentic breakfast and then through the beautiful countryside to the first vineyard/winery. It was beautiful and the wine tastings were great. He then took us on a walking tour of Ronda which was spectacular and we wrapped up with a visit to a very small organic vineyard and had wonderful wine and one of the best lunches we had during the entire visit to Spain. I would highly recommend Marbella-In-Style and be sure to ask for Julio. You won’t be disappointed!!

opiniones.author: Charlie and Linda (Iowa)
opiniones.title: "Julio is the Best"
opiniones.content: We did two tours with Julio, one to Ronda and the other to Morocco. Julio was very knowledgeable and most accommodating to all out needs. When in Morocco we were met by his associate and driver. Julio was with us there also, didn’t just send us on the ferry and tell us to look for them. We felt very safe at all times. Can’t thank him enough, when we go back which we will he will definitely be our tour guide again.
